items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: String sextet actually, of Billie Holiday tunes.

ctx.x: Yeah. Rich Perry. That would be a whole other thing. He’s a great player but not in the same way as Mark. [He’s] not into the Tristano thing at all as far as I know. There’s another record that interests me, I haven’t had a chance to hear it but, Daniel Schnyder did some string quartet things.
String sextet actually, of Billie Holiday tunes.
He’s somebody I have a lot of respect for as a writer.
